name: Drinking And Driving
overview: Scripture warns against the dangers and folly of excessive drinking, highlighting that wine and strong drink can deceive, inflame, and lead to poor judgment, as seen in Proverbs 20:1 and Isaiah 28:7. God commands sobriety in sacred service (Leviticus 10:9) and honors those who abstain from alcohol, filling them with the Holy Spirit instead (Luke 1:15; Ephesians 5:18). The warnings extend to all who pursue strong drink from morning until night, emphasizing the spiritual and practical consequences of drunkenness (Isaiah 5:11).
